Practised making one mark for each object.
Matched marks back to objects to check for missing items.
Used “cross off” for removing a mark.

end.parentNote: Asha practised one-to-one marking with sheep and pebbles. Parth used recounting to correct the mix-up between five and six marks and identified that each mark represented one sheep. At home, ask them to place one small mark beside each spoon, toy, or pencil, then match the marks back to the objects.
